newsitem.title: MACAU: China executes eight for drug trafficking, murder.
newsitem.headline: China executes eight for drug trafficking, murder.

text.p: China executed eight men in Zhuhai, Guangdong province, on Thursday after they were found guilty of drug trafficking and murder, a court official said.
All eight Chinese nationals were led promptly to a firing squad after the Zhuhai Intermediate People's Court handed them death sentences, a court spokesman told reporters.
Five were found guilty of trafficking drugs and three others of murder, he said.
The court also meted out severe punishments to two Macau Chinese residents found guilty of heroin trafficking.
Lam Wai Man, 39, was given a death sentence but with a two-year suspension, while Ng Kam Tong, 35, was sentenced to 15 years in prison.
Both were arrested together in Zhuhai in January.
